# Integrate AgentDojo with shared replay and SHE/EvoSafe recipes

## Change

Integrate official AgentDojo's banking, Slack, travel and workspace suites with Hermit. Reuse AgentDyn's supervised native replay, shared `direct` Base Agent victim, usage accounting, episode deadlines, Docker defense hooks and native verdict contract. AgentDyn remains the default in the shared runtime; no framework core or method algorithm changes.

Add frozen-case preparation, a benchmark comparison protocol, public tool schemas with the upstream MIT notice, native regression tests, and matching SHE/EvoSafe Lightning/Codex recipes. The official AgentDojo checkout and AgentDyn fork both install `agentdojo`, so they use separate environments.

The [comparison protocol](https://github.com/safetytest123/hermit/blob/feat/agentdojo-integration/examples/agentdojo/utils/DATA.md) imports existing `tool_knowledge` logs from the pinned official checkout at `089ed468cf3ed0322acc66b0211f26d9d90dbf60`, using native task version `v1.2.2`. Old model traces/scores do not select cases or enter prepared rows. Native initialization/no-op checks exclude 45 already-utility-true cases before splitting. Seed 20261117 produces 57 TRAIN/54 reserved-validation/406 TEST cases, with 19/18/55 disjoint user-task groups. TRAIN/validation keep two existing goals per group; TEST keeps all eligible recorded goals. Historical Workspace logs cover six goal IDs, rather than every current native registration. Data SHA-256: `d50945a77e81afb21a7556a10b29d1989a99c4822eabd45f81c4d67013f0d65e`.

Both comparison recipes use a frozen `nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning` actor, concurrency 12, temperature 0, 8192 output tokens and 25 tool iterations; GPT-6 Sol/high Codex learners; and TRAIN-only selection with validation unused. Existing method settings differ: EvoSafe has three proposals and a 12/57 source cascade with four auxiliary-judge calls; SHE has 20 full TRAIN rounds, the upstream measured-best selector and eight judge calls. This is matched data/victim evaluation, not equal compute. Existing templates/Evolvers and their upstream adaptations are retained; see the [method comparison and execution details](https://github.com/safetytest123/hermit/blob/feat/agentdojo-integration/examples/agentdojo/README.md).

Real 2026-11-17 comparisons froze source at `f829fc91390d81c992fbd6a90cb56e19d8b5396c`. **These are single-pass reference measurements** under the frozen local protocol. Exact completed-case denominators, all planned-case errors and repeat variability are retained in the result records.

| Experiment / adapter | Clean utility | ASR | Safe injected completion | Errors / planned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EvoSafe / None | 47/54 (87.0%) | 81/344 (23.5%) | 214/344 (62.2%) | 8/406 |
| EvoSafe / Initial | 49/55 (89.1%) | 57/344 (16.6%) | 240/344 (69.8%) | 7/406 |
| EvoSafe / Final | 48/55 (87.3%) | 8/347 (2.3%) | 264/347 (76.1%) | 4/406 |
| SHE / None | 50/55 (90.9%) | 73/343 (21.3%) | 222/343 (64.7%) | 8/406 |
| SHE / Initial | 50/54 (92.6%) | 59/345 (17.1%) | 239/345 (69.3%) | 7/406 |
| SHE / Final | 48/54 (88.9%) | 12/343 (3.5%) | 267/343 (77.8%) | 9/406 |

Every row covers the same 406 planned IDs. Rates use completed-case denominators; failed executions are never secure verdicts, and complete-run native defense objectives are unavailable. Both final adapters improve observed ASR/safe completion while clean utility falls against their initial seeds. EvoSafe errors fall 7 to 4; SHE errors rise 7 to 9. A single pass, shared user groups, unequal method budgets and repeat variability preclude a significance or universal-ranking claim.

EvoSafe's three candidates all have approved independent Criticizer records; only trial 1 was accepted, and its three files exactly match final. SHE completed 20 rounds and promoted best records 2/6/9, exporting the round 9 measured best. Rounds 6 and 9 contain the **same** artifact; their score difference is repeat variability, not another learned artifact update. The unmeasured round 20 proposal is excluded. SHE's final rule bank/tool policy change; system prompt/memory remain seed content. Native clean UBR/signed-registry integrity remain unavailable, as documented task adaptations.

Full denominators, paired changes, hashes, adapter identities, token buckets, unknown dollar costs, runtime limitations and local artifact locations are in the [EvoSafe results](https://github.com/safetytest123/hermit/blob/feat/agentdojo-integration/examples/agentdojo/evosafe/README.md#results) and [SHE results](https://github.com/safetytest123/hermit/blob/feat/agentdojo-integration/examples/agentdojo/she/README.md#results). Generated data, trajectories and per-run snapshots remain ignored, as required.

## Validation

- Actual shared experiment entry point: both frozen `train/none/root/final` runs complete; 2,436 TEST records are independently recomputed against saved comparisons with exact ID coverage. Framework source, victim, task/train/test hashes, backend-file hashes and pinned hook image match across methods. Real seed smoke cases and Codex structured-output preflight passed before search.
- `python -m pytest examples/agentdojo/utils/tests tests/core/test_selection.py -q --durations=3`: **34 passed** at final content (~22s), including official native tools/judges, real supervisor/model-client paths with a local scripted HTTP model, all four suites and actual Docker SHE/structured hooks.
- Focused task/protocol/experiment-runtime/review checks: **64 passed, 4 skipped**. New tests cover old-score stripping, deterministic group ownership and 57/54 budgets, full TEST variants, interleaved cascade coverage, source identity and recipe propagation. Tests use temporary paths/local stand-ins, optional native/Docker dependencies and no provider credentials or external model calls.
- `python -m pytest --changed` with the official AgentDojo+SHE environment at last functional-code head `f829fc9`: **998 passed, 157 skipped, 32 failed**. Unchanged base `616e818` with the same environment and core/evosafe/she groups: **972 passed, 142 skipped, 32 failed**. XML failure-ID sets match exactly: **no new failures**. Existing failures cover platform requirements and AgentDyn-only/native-parser expectations under official AgentDojo. The branch command also collects eligible example tests, so total counts differ beyond new regressions. Subsequent commits change documentation only.
- Required offline framework walkthrough `hermit check/train/eval --adapter final` passed with `/tmp` output; final mean 1.0, zero errors. Actual new comparison configs also passed shared entry/role/template preflights and `hermit check --no-probe` in their recorded runtime profiles.
- `bash docs/build.sh`, `git diff --check` and programmatic documentation readback pass. Every table fraction/percentage, error count, source/hash and catalog placement matches retained records. Installed official checkout is clean at 089ed468; installed SHE is pinned to 0c656460.
- Error taxonomy checked: all 19 EvoSafe errors lack terminal assistant responses; SHE has 22 nonterminal episodes, one protocol missing-terminal-answer failure and one output-limit truncation. No hook-interface failure is indicated. Dollar prices are unconfigured, not zero cost. Some platform enforcement checks remain unverified on this host.
